systematic_failure_review.rationale: Across twelve candidates per arm, the gated arm had three flow-inconclusive outcomes and one mesh-inconclusive timeout. The ungated arm had the same three flow-inconclusive mechanisms, two mesh-inconclusive outcomes, and two additional unmeshable failures. No failure family was unique to or concentrated in the gated arm; gated mesh usability was 11/12 versus 8/12. The evidence therefore does not support a coherent new failure mechanism induced by gate-conditioned search.
